subject: general
question: In which year was the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1982**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development** (NABARD) was established in **1982**. 
 
• National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (**NABARD**) is an apex regulatory body for the overall regulation of regional rural banks and apex cooperative banks in India.
 
• It is under the jurisdiction of the **Ministry of Finance**, Government of India.
 
• The bank has been **entrusted** with "matters concerning policy, planning, and operations in the field of credit for agriculture and other economic activities in rural areas in India".
 
• NABARD is active in developing and implementing** financial inclusion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NABARD operates at **32 Regional Offices** in the country.
 
• NABARD conducted statutory inspections of **338** banks with reference to financial position as on 31 March 2019.
 
• These included **32** StCBs, **253** DCCBs and **45** RRBs.
 
• **Reserve Bank of India** divests its share in NABARD and NHB.
 
• With this, the Government of India now holds** 100%** stake in both the financial institutions.
